task:
sqlparse.format(sql, strip_comments=True) deletes optimizer hints, which changes what the query does. Hints must stay, and ordinary comments must still go.

These must come back unchanged:
- 'select --+full(u)'
- '#+ hint\nselect * from foo'
- 'SELECT /*+cluster(T)*/* FROM T_EEE T where A >:1'
- 'insert /*+ DIRECT */ into sch.table_name as select * from foo'

When a hint and an ordinary comment appear together, only the ordinary comment goes:
- 'select --+full(u)\n--comment simple' must become 'select --+full(u)\n'
- '#+ hint\nselect * from foo\n# comment simple' must become '#+ hint\nselect * from foo\n'

The empty string must still give the empty string: sqlparse.format('', strip_comments=True) == ''.

The formatter must finish on every input, including input where a hint comes before or after other comments.

Everything else must keep working, including the existing whitespace handling when an ordinary comment is removed.
accept: PYTHONPATH=.bench-deps python3 -m pytest -q -o addopts= -p no:cacheprovider tests
